headline: Crash Bandicoot - PlayStation mascot
title: Crash Bandicoot 1996 | PS1 Classic Facts | Classic Games
video_script: Crash Bandicoot became a PlayStation icon. The first game was developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment, and it was released in Japan on August thirty first, nineteen ninety six. You spin, jump and run to stop Doctor Neo Cortex. Which Crash game was your favourite? Comment below!
description: Crash Bandicoot launched on PlayStation in Japan on August 31, 1996, developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment.
